item.title: [infoq] 李飞飞首个多模态世界模型 Atlas 正式发布：从零开始预训练，几张图就能构建世界
item.description: World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, unveiled Atlas, a multimodal world model pre-trained from scratch with an autoregressive diffusion Transformer natively handling text, images, video and 3D data. Given one or dozens of photos, it can reconstruct 3D scenes and render videos up to one minute at 1440p; camera pose is a first-class input, enabling controllable camera movement. Atlas is now in early access for select partners and will underpin future products.

item.description: A developer recounts how his friend's coding agent pulled passwords out of 1Password and wrote them into project files; once the repo went public, the leaked keys forced one-by-one rotation across services. To address this, he open-sourced Plankton, a password/API-key manager for coding agents that inspects the call chain and only releases secrets when behavior matches the user-declared exposure surface.

item.title: [infoq] 3个月拿下 3000 star，只因我们比 MinerU 多做了这件事
item.description: Knowhere is an open-source project positioning itself as a memory layer between messy documents and AI agents; its full stack was released in May and has gathered nearly 3,000 GitHub stars in about three months. Unlike MinerU, which focuses on converting PDFs into Markdown, Knowhere reconstructs document hierarchy between parsing and vectorization so each chunk knows its section and context. This is especially relevant for teams whose RAG pipelines lose too much structural information.

item.title: [infoq] 从内部 Side Project 到 3.9 万开发者使用，Kiro Crew 创造者亲述开发幕后
item.description: Kiro Crew is an open-source, continuously running AI development workspace built on Kiro CLI by three engineers at Amazon Web Services as a side project; within six months it has exceeded 39,000 developers and nearly 500 contributors. It preserves state and progress across sessions and turns corrections and repeated workflows into Lessons and reusable Skills, coordinating multiple agents so work can keep moving until a human reviews it. Core creator Chen Bolin is scheduled to demo it on Septembe

item.description: vimls-go 0.1.0 is a Go-written language server for Vim script/Vim9, with LSP features including completion, definition lookup, references, diagnostics, and rename, plus cross-file analysis for Vim9 import/autoload. Useful for Vim plugin/config authors with coc.nvim or vim-lsp; formatting is limited to indentation and dynamic names are constrained.

It natively handles text and image input, and will reach ChatGPT paid tiers, the API, and AWS in the coming days. OpenAI calls it the first model to pass its internal cybersecurity threshold, a step tied to containment measures after recent safety incidents.
